parsed.scene_description: A dimly lit warehouse aisle flanked by tall metal racks filled with stacked wooden crates and blue plastic bins. The floor is concrete, and overhead lights cast bright spots. A forklift is visible in the distance. The perspective suggests a low camera angle looking down the aisle.

objects.label: wooden crate
objects.observation: Large, light-brown wooden crate on left side of aisle, partially obscuring view. Has white label with black numbers '5814278'. Appears to be on a pallet. Partially shadowed.

objects.label: metal shelving rack
objects.observation: Tall, dark blue metal shelving unit extending from left foreground into background. Holds multiple layers of wooden crates. Vertical posts and horizontal beams form its structure. Partially occludes view of items behind it.

objects.label: blue plastic bins
objects.observation: Stacks of bright blue plastic bins on right-hand shelves. Arranged neatly in rows. Visible against the far wall and along the aisle. Reflects overhead lighting.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift parked in the distant background, centered between the two aisles. Its mast and forks are visible. Appears stationary under fluorescent lights.

objects.label: overhead light fixture
objects.observation: Bright, rectangular fluorescent light fixtures mounted high on ceiling. Emit strong downward illumination. Cast shadows on the floor and racks below. Multiple fixtures visible.
